ui.tz_milestone_guide: Mukandu wa dîba & diandamuna (UTC{tz_str}): Tshizubu tshidi tshishintulula dîba dia nzedi; kusesula UTC kudi mua kupesha mulami mu dituku dikpadiapeshi anyi dikpadia.
ui.tz_col_target: Dîba dia UTC{tz_str} & Dishintulula dia Dituku
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Mashini wa Dîba: Sesula matuku kumbukumbu anyi kumpala mu tshizubu bua kutangila bia kale anyi bia kumpala/malongolola, kufuanyikija malu a kale, ne kuenza malu a ntontonshisho. KUTANGILA NANSHA; bia mu nshubu kabiyi bienzejibua.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN base: ṅudi midilu ya bine, uebelela tshilelu tsha phase & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter pa k, p; pa bipalu 16 / 116 / 132 nansha tshikondo 1072 udi wenza k*116 + p*16 pa k, p bua kusekesha phase, ubebeza bipalu kumpala bikalaku bipeke.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Udi usela tshilelu 119 (k*119 + jitter); padibi bipalu 16 / 116 / 132 nansha kukuata tshikondo 1072 (tshilejilu tsha matshina 14), udi wenza k*116 + p*16 pa k, p bua kuyila mu Phase A idi ikumbane (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Udi upepula tshilelu 119 (k*119 + jitter); pa bipalu 16 / 116 / 132 nansha tshikondo 1072 (k*116 + p*16 pa k, p), udi wanyisha phase mifikile A2 / C7 ne kupingana kunyima bikalaku midilu mianyi.
